UPDATE settlement_pending_data SET settlement_status = #{settlementStatus}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE pending_id = #{pendingId}

UPDATE settlement_pending_data SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, approval_user = #{approvalUser}, approval_time = NOW(), approval_notes = #{approvalNotes}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE pending_id = #{pendingId}
UPDATE settlement_pending_data SET bank_transaction_no = #{bankTransactionNo}, actual_settlement_date = NOW(), update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE pending_id = #{pendingId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_pending_data WHERE priority IN ('HIGH', 'URGENT') AND settlement_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, create_time ASC

SELECT * FROM settlement_pending_data WHERE expected_settlement_date < CURDATE() AND settlement_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'PROCESSING') AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY expected_settlement_date ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN settlement_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN settlement_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN settlement_status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN settlement_status = 'SETTLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as settledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN settlement_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedCount, SUM(settlement_amount) as totalAmount, AVG(settlement_amount) as avgAmount, MAX(settlement_amount) as maxAmount, MIN(settlement_amount) as minAmount FROM settlement_pending_data WHERE org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT * FROM settlement_pending_data WHERE settlement_status = 'APPROVED' AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, expected_settlement_date ASC, create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM settlement_pending_data WHERE settlement_status = 'FAILED' AND org_id = #{orgId} AND (retry_count IS NULL OR retry_count < #{maxRetryCount}) ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_pending_data SET retry_count = COALESCE(retry_count, 0) + 1, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE pending_id = #{pendingId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_pending_data WHERE ( settlement_amount >= #{largeAmountThreshold} OR priority = 'URGENT' OR expected_settlement_date < CURDATE() ) AND settlement_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'PROCESSING') AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN settlement_amount >= #{largeAmountThreshold} THEN 1 WHEN priority = 'URGENT' THEN 2 WHEN expected_settlement_date < CURDATE() THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, settlement_amount DESC

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(settlement_amount) as totalAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN settlement_status = 'SETTLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as settledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN settlement_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failedCount FROM settlement_pending_data WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time)
